title: Ebiten: Kouritsu Ebisugawa Koukou Tenmonbu Specials
justification: AniList 16508 has 5 episodes (2012-11-30 to 2013-03-29); an offline-database synonym is 'Dokidoki no Onsen Gasshuku'. AniDB 8860 S1-S5 are 'Dokidoki no Onsen Gasshuku Sono 1..5' on 2012-11-30, 12-28, 2013-01-25, 02-22, 03-29. TVDB 259656 0x01-0x05 are 'Heart Throb Hot Springs 1..5' on exactly those dates; TMDB tv/54928 S0E1-5 agree. S6, S7 (event digests) are other items; 0x06 is AniDB 9245 (Megazone 23 Part II, placed by overlay/9245.json).
